partners.name: Preva
partners.story:
Preva Aesthetics, founded by Michelle Paty, MSN, CPNP-AC, FNP-C, is a modern aesthetics practice with locations in Encinitas, California and Denver, Colorado. Built on a philosophy of natural beauty and preventative care, Preva has established itself as a trusted destination for patients seeking refined, subtle results delivered through a highly personalized approach.

Michelle Paty brings a distinctive perspective to the field of aesthetics, shaped by her background in pediatric critical care and her longstanding passion for holistic wellness. Her approach emphasizes balance, restraint, and long-term skin health, allowing patients to achieve refreshed, confident results while maintaining the features that make them uniquely themselves. Through her thoughtful leadership and commitment to excellence, Michelle has cultivated a practice known for both elevated care and genuine patient connection.

At the heart of Preva is a belief that aesthetic medicine should feel approachable and intentional. This philosophy is reflected throughout every aspect of the practice, from the patient experience to the treatment approach itself. By combining modern aesthetic techniques with an emphasis on education and prevention, Preva continues to redefine what thoughtful aesthetic care can look like.

partners.name: LexRx
partners.story:
LexRx is a nurse practitioner–owned aesthetic practice based in Massachusetts, known for its evidence-based approach to aesthetic medicine and its commitment to safety, clinical expertise, and patient education. Founded in 2015 by Board-Certified Nurse Practitioner Alexa Nicholls Costa, LexRx has grown into a respected multi-location practice serving clients across Beacon Hill, South Boston, Nantucket, Charlestown, and the Seaport district.The practice offers aesthetic injectables, skin rejuvenation treatments, and its award-winning LexRx medical-grade skincare line, recognized as Best of Boston for its clinically proven approach to improving skin health. Treatments include neuromodulators such as Botox®, hyaluronic acid dermal fillers, and biostimulatory therapies like poly-L-lactic acid, all delivered by Board-Certified Nurse Practitioners with experience at some of the nation’s leading hospitals.Beyond patient care, LexRx plays an active role in advancing education within aesthetic medicine.

Through its training platform, Inject With Lex, the organization has developed university-affiliated injectables training programs in partnership with institutions including Boston College, Columbia University, and the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill. These programs combine academic curriculum with hands-on training to promote evidence-based practice and raise the standards of clinical safety across the industry.LexRx also supports providers through LexLab, a fully licensed pharmaceutical distributor and clinical support platform that offers qualified clinicians access to compliant product purchasing, medical directorship, and operational resources.Through its commitment to clinical excellence, education, and innovation, LexRx continues to help shape the future of aesthetic medicine while delivering thoughtful, results-driven care for every patient it serves.

partners.name: Prive
partners.story:
Privé Med Spa is a nationally recognized medical aesthetics practice based in Lexington, Kentucky, known for its uncompromising standards in safety, clinical excellence, and patient experience. Widely regarded as one of the region’s premier medical spas, Privé was built on the belief that trust, integrity, and education are foundational to exceptional aesthetic outcomes.

From the very first consultation, Privé emphasizes partnership. Each patient journey begins with thoughtful education and personalized guidance, ensuring that treatments are aligned not only with aesthetic goals but also with long-term confidence and well-being. This philosophy has earned Privé a reputation for natural-looking results delivered with precision, care, and discretion.

As a true medical spa, Privé operates at the highest level of medical oversight and ethics. The practice offers advanced injectables, body contouring, skin rejuvenation, and physician-grade skincare within a refined, spa-like environment. Its team includes nationally recognized Master Injectors, Allergan Medical Institute trainers, SkinMedica speakers, licensed estheticians, and CoolSculpting specialists—professionals selected for both their technical expertise and their artistic eye.Privé’s clinical excellence is further reflected in its distinction as a Diamond Top 100 Allergan partner, placing the practice among the top 1% of providers nationwide utilizing gold-standard aesthetic injectables and medical-grade skincare. This designation underscores Privé’s commitment to safety, outcomes, and consistent patient satisfaction.

Beyond the treatment room, Privé is deeply rooted in service to its community. The practice proudly supports Refuge for Women, a nonprofit organization dedicated to helping women heal and rebuild after human trafficking or sexual exploitation. This commitment reflects Privé’s broader mission: to serve as both a sanctuary for aesthetic care and a force for meaningful impact within Central Kentucky and beyond.With an unwavering dedication to excellence, ethics, and artistry, Privé Med Spa continues to set the standard for sophisticated, results-driven aesthetic care.

partners.name: Mint + Needle
partners.story:
Mint & Needle, founded in 2019 by Brandi Gregge, MSN, FNP-BC, stands as a paragon of science-driven medical aesthetics with two flourishing locations in Lewes and Middletown, Delaware. This med spa was created with a profound vision: to offer regenerative medical aesthetics that not only enhance natural beauty but also foster a deep sense of confidence and well-being.
Brandi Gregge, a dynamic leader with a rich educational background including a Master's in Nursing and an MBA, brings over a decade of medical and aesthetics expertise to Mint & Needle. Under her guidance, the spa has achieved notable accolades including being named Delaware Today’s 2024 Best of Delaware® - Best MedSpa Downstate, and Philadelphia Style's 2023 Best MedSpa. Her approach extends beyond superficial treatments; she has established an intensive internal residency program for all medical injectors at Mint & Needle, ensuring that the team is not only proficient in the latest techniques but also deeply committed to safety and patient education.
‍

The med spa’s environment is crafted to be an oasis of tranquility, a space where every individual—regardless of gender or background—is welcomed and celebrated. This inclusive approach is complemented by a suite of medical-grade products. Mint & Needle not only serves as a local sanctuary for beauty and wellness but also as a beacon of innovation in aesthetic medicine.
‍

Mint & Needle’s ethos of “EmpowerMint, EnhanceMint, and NourishMint” reflects Brandi’s belief in the transformative power of aesthetic medicine to boost inner confidence and promote wellness. This philosophy resonates through every treatment and product, ensuring that clients leave feeling empowered and rejuvenated. With a steadfast commitment to excellence and a compassionate approach to patient care, Mint & Needle continues to redefine the standards of aesthetic medicine, making it a distinguished name in the industry.

partners.name: Flawless Medspa + Wellness
partners.story:
Flawless Med Spa & Wellness, located in Albuquerque, New Mexico, stands as a beacon of inclusivity and quality in the realm of aesthetic treatments and wellness services. Founded in 2011 by Heather and John Badal, this local, woman-owned family business has flourished into a prominent feature of New Mexico's beauty and wellness landscape, welcoming thousands of satisfied clients from diverse backgrounds.

‍
Under the leadership of Heather, a visionary with a rich background in international business and a deep commitment to community service, Flawless Med Spa & Wellness has become known for its warm, inclusive atmosphere. Heather's passion for integrating beauty with wellness shines through in every facet of the spa's operations, from the meticulously maintained treatment rooms to the cutting-edge technology employed in their services.

‍
John Badal, President and co-owner, brings his expertise from a successful medical technology background, enhancing Flawless’s outreach and technological adoption. His strategic vision has been pivotal in expanding Flawless Med Spa's capabilities, including introducing state-of-the-art treatments like CoolSculpting Elite and PicoSure Laser technology, making Flawless a pioneer in New Mexico for advanced aesthetic procedures.

‍
Jason, the on-site Medical Director, adds a critical layer of expertise and passion to the team. With his background as a Flight Nurse and his ongoing studies in Dermatology, Jason’s medical oversight ensures that every treatment not only meets but exceeds health and safety standards. His dedication to patient care and his unique approach to wellness and aesthetics greatly enhance the patient experience.

‍
Flawless Med Spa & Wellness is more than just a med spa; it's an oasis in the chaotic world. Each visit is designed to be a comforting escape from daily stresses, where patients can rejuvenate and attain their beauty and health goals in a serene environment. The team’s commitment to continuous learning and adoption of the latest in aesthetic technology ensures that Flawless remains at the forefront of the industry, providing tailored treatments that cater to the unique needs of each patient.
In essence, Flawless Med Spa & Wellness embodies a holistic approach to beauty and wellness, ensuring that every client leaves feeling beautiful, confident, and part of the Flawless family.

partners.name: Inbloom Health + Medispa
partners.story:
Inbloom Health + Medispa, nestled in Londonderry, New Hampshire, emerges as a quintessential medispa blending wellness with advanced aesthetic treatments. Spearheaded by Dr. Tanya Lawson, ND, a visionary in integrative health, Inbloom is dedicated to providing personalized care tailored to meet each patient’s unique goals. Since its inception in 2015 by Dr. Lawson, Inbloom has quickly ascended to the forefront of aesthetic and wellness care in the region.

‍
Dr. Tanya Lawson began her illustrious career in 2006, founding integrative health centers and a medical spa renowned for its noninvasive dermatological and anti-aging procedures. Her pioneering work has not only garnered regional acclaim, earning her the title of Young Entrepreneur of the Year, but also national recognition with accolades like “Best Doctor” in the Best of Windham awards in 2020 and 2021, and multiple Best of the 603 awards in 2024. Dr. Lawson’s extensive experience includes consulting for prominent healthcare institutions and participating in influential research, with her studies presented at national conferences.

‍
The ethos of Inbloom Health + Medispa centers around creating a boutique environment where elegance and personalized attention converge to offer unparalleled service. The medispa caters to a broad audience in Londonderry and surrounding communities such as Windham, Derry, and Salem, ensuring accessibility and convenience for all clients. With a focus on anti-aging, whole-body wellness, and aesthetic enhancements, Inbloom utilizes the latest treatments and approaches to help clients achieve their health and beauty aspirations.
Dr. Lawson’s commitment to patient education and empowerment stands out, with a proactive approach that encourages patients to actively participate in their wellness journeys. Beyond her professional endeavors, Dr. Lawson is a dedicated volunteer and a fervent advocate for continuous learning in the medical field. Her approachable demeanor and expert guidance make her a trusted figure among her patients and peers.

‍
Inbloom Health + Medispa not only promises transformative results but also a journey enriched with care, expertise, and a commitment to achieving the best possible outcomes for each individual. Under Dr. Lawson’s leadership, Inbloom continues to set benchmarks in the field of medical aesthetics and wellness.

partners.name: Cami Aesthetics
partners.story:
Cami Aesthetics provides state-of-the-art cosmetic treatments aimed at revitalizing and enhancing natural beauty across its two North Carolina locations in Greensboro and Huntersville. Cami Aesthetics offers a comprehensive range of minimally invasive and advanced aesthetic procedures delivered by an experienced clinical team committed to safe, high-quality outcomes.

Since its inception, Cami Aestheticshas been driven by a commitment to honesty, integrity, and compassion in aesthetic medical care. This dedication has earned the practice multiple accolades, including several “Best of the City” and “Best of the Lake” awards, along with recognition for “Best Non-Surgical Facelift 2017” at The Aesthetic Show in Las Vegas.

Cami Aesthetics not only aims to deliver exceptional aesthetic results but also strives to be a leading training center for aesthetic medicine in North Carolina. The team is well-trained in the latest techniques, ensuring that from the initial consultation to follow-up visits, each patient receives personalized care tailored to their specific needs. The relaxed and secure environment at Cami, combined with a focus on exceeding expectations, helps each visit leave patients feeling younger and more confident.

At Cami Aesthetics, the goal is not only to enhance external beauty, but also to support each patient’s overall confidence and well-being through thoughtful care, education, and a results-driven approach.

partners.name: Dontage
partners.story:
Dontage, located in Fairfax, VA, is a distinguished med spa that stands out for its commitment to luxury, precision, and exceptional aesthetic outcomes. Founded by Waseem Garbia, PA-C, a board-certified physician associate with over 21 years of medical experience, Dontage has become a beacon of innovation and high-quality care in medical aesthetics. Specializing for 12 years in aesthetics, Waseem has earned national acclaim not only as a top injector but also as an esteemed trainer for leading aesthetic companies like Allergan and Revance.

Waseem's extensive background spans critical cardiology, general and plastic surgery, emergency surgery, and notably, skin and aesthetics. His deep knowledge of the latest lasers, injectables, and clinical-grade cosmeceuticals ensures that each treatment at Dontage is not only effective but tailored to the individual needs of each patient. This bespoke approach challenges the misconception that all aesthetic providers are the same, promising natural and superior results.

At Dontage, patients are welcomed into a luxurious setting where every detail is crafted to provide a VIP experience. The clinic’s philosophy is simple yet impactful: to create an inviting and professional atmosphere where patients leave feeling beautiful and confident. The team of advanced injectors and medical professionals at Dontage is dedicated to anti-aging treatments and enhancing facial features for all ages and genders, offering a customized anti-aging skincare regimen designed to maintain youthful and vibrant skin.

Waseem Garbia's commitment extends beyond treatments; he is a passionate mentor and international speaker, actively participating in numerous advisory boards and teaching at major facial aesthetic conferences worldwide. His dedication to education and community building within the field of medical aesthetics ensures that Dontage not only delivers exceptional patient care but also leads in the advancement of aesthetic practices.

partners.name: RN Esthetics
partners.story:
RN Esthetics, an acclaimed medical aesthetics practice, boasts three elegant locations in Salem, Newburyport, and Lynnfield, Massachusetts. Under the leadership of co-founder and Clinical Director Michelle Doran, RN Esthetics has become a beacon of excellence in the realm of minimally invasive cosmetic treatments. The practice is nationally recognized as an Allergan Top 500 Provider of BOTOX & Dermal Fillers, a Black Diamond HydraFacial practice, and holds the prestigious position as a top Skin Better account in New England.

Founded in 2012, RN Esthetics prides itself on a highly skilled team consisting of Nurse Practitioners, Registered Nurses, and Master Estheticians. The team is dedicated to combining beauty with medicine to achieve safe and effective results. Their commitment to excellence is evident in their numerous accolades, including over 30 Best of Northshore (BONS) awards from Northshore Magazine and a consistent record of ‘Best Med Spa’ since 2013.

The practice’s mission is to enhance the health and beauty of the skin through the best products, services, and technology available. With a focus on excellence, RN Esthetics continues to set high standards in the aesthetic field, as demonstrated by their impressive statistics: over 550 5-star Google reviews, more than 234,200 Botox units administered, and recognition as a top 14 ZO Account nationally. This commitment to quality and patient satisfaction ensures that RN Esthetics remains a leader in aesthetic medicine on the North Shore.

partners.name: Anne Therese Aesthetic Medicine
partners.story:
Anne Therese Aesthetic Medicine, with four thriving locations across Columbus, Ohio, Cape Coral and Bonita Springs, Florida stands as a beacon of excellence in minimally invasive aesthetic medicine under the stewardship of Dr. Anne Therese Stubbs, MD. The practice is renowned for high-quality treatments and a deep commitment to patient-centered care, a testament to Dr. Stubbs's extensive training with world experts and her active membership in the American Academy of Cosmetic Surgery.

Dr. Stubbs's affiliation with ZO Skin Health and Galderma not only underscores her proficiency in facial injectables but also positions her as a pivotal figure in training injectors nationwide. This expertise now amplifies the capabilities of Alpha Aesthetics Partners, with whom Anne Therese Aesthetic Medicine has forged a strategic partnership. This collaboration marks a significant step towards enhancing the scope and quality of care in the dynamic field of aesthetic medicine, aligning with Dr. Stubbs's vision of providing exceptional patient care and outcomes through industry-leading practices.

Echoing the sentiments of partnership and excellence, John Wheeler, CEO of Alpha Aesthetics Partners, lauds Dr. Stubbs and her team as elite additions to the network, poised to elevate the standards of aesthetic care. Anne Therese Aesthetic Medicine, through this synergy, continues to offer unparalleled patient experiences, combining the personal touch of a local practice with the expansive resources and expertise of a national brand.

partners.name: Williams Center
partners.story:
The Williams Center, a prominent name in cosmetic surgery, excels as a top destination for those seeking specialized care in facial plastic surgery, medical spa services, and hair restoration. Founded in 1992 by Edwin Williams III, MD, FACS, it has become a go-to center for patients globally, thanks to its strategic location near Albany International Airport and proximity to New York City.

Under the visionary leadership of Dr. Edwin F. Williams III, the center has set a high bar in cosmetic surgery. Dr. Williams is not just the founder but a key influencer, notably leading a facial plastic surgery fellowship program, mentoring two fellows annually. His focus on advanced patient care and commitment to medical education has reinforced the center's esteemed reputation.

The Williams Center is dedicated to offering world-class plastic surgery services. With a team of certified, highly experienced doctors, each specializing in their specific field, the center guarantees exceptional results. Dr. Williams focuses on facial operations, Dr. Lloreda on breast and body surgery, Dr. Slaughter on hair transplants and facial reconstruction, and Dr. Lee on facial plastics and reconstructive surgery. This level of specialization sets The Williams Center apart from other practices.

Adding to its impressive portfolio, The Rejuva Center at Williams provides patients with the latest in nonsurgical cosmetic innovations like Botox, Fillers, and Coolsculpting. These treatments are designed to reduce wrinkles, improve skin, and reshape the face, sometimes in just one session. The team, guided by Dr. Williams, offers personalized care, ensuring each treatment aligns with the patient's unique needs.

The Saratoga Hair Center at Williams has been a leader in hair restoration surgery since 1989, serving the Saratoga Springs, NY area. Understanding the significance of the hair restoration journey, the center treats every patient like family, offering personalized and compassionate care.

The Williams Center's mission revolves around providing state-of-the-art cosmetic procedures with a focus on safety, results, and impacting patients' lives positively. The center is committed to educating both current and future patients about all available treatment options.

Having earned the trust and respect of patients and colleagues over decades, The Williams Center strives to enhance lives with compassionate care and advanced medical techniques. It stands not just as a medical facility but as a family, dedicated to providing the best environment for patient care and medical excellence. This commitment to patient care, education, and teaching at all levels further solidifies The Williams Center's position as a leader in the cosmetic surgery industry.

partners.name: the Laser Center of Marin
partners.story:
The Laser Center of Marin (TLC), owned and operated by Kevin and Denise Jones since 2003, stands as a testament to personalized aesthetic care in Marin County. Its guiding philosophy focuses on enhancing the well-being of its clients by aiding them in looking and feeling their best. This locally-owned center distinguishes itself from franchise operations with its deep community ties, highlighting a long-term commitment to the area's residents.

TLC's exceptional customer service ensures patients receive timely appointments, fostering a comfortable environment where no one feels rushed. The personalized approach is further enhanced by the practitioners' efforts to develop individual relationships with patients, tailoring treatments to meet their specific aesthetic aspirations.

Underpinning TLC's success is its dedication to utilizing the latest technology in laser treatments. This commitment allows TLC to offer a wide range of options for various aesthetic needs, a significant advantage over smaller clinics with limited resources. Their independence from specific manufacturers also empowers them to select the best equipment in the market, ensuring top-notch results for their patients.

Safety and expertise are paramount at The Laser Center of Marin. Dr. Bradley Greene, M.D., FACS, the Medical Director, is a Board Certified specialist in Facial Plastic Surgery and Head and Neck Reconstructive Surgery. Dr. Greene's expertise is a valuable asset, as he devotes and limits his practice exclusively to facial plastic, cosmetic, and rejuvenation procedures, ensuring high-level proficiency and focus in these areas.

TLC's high standard of care and safety is further evidenced by its recognition as one of the largest laser clinics in the Bay Area, with prestigious Black Diamond and Platinum Level designations from Allergan and Galderma. These accolades underscore the center's experienced injectors who deliver excellent results safely.

Patient testimonials, like Charlene K.'s from 2021, reflect TLC's commitment to excellence. Patients praise the center for its skilled and professional staff, friendly and helpful service, and high satisfaction with treatments. The emphasis on clear communication and a relaxing treatment experience is a hallmark of TLC's patient-centered approach.

The Laser Center of Marin, with its dedicated ownership and expert medical direction, strives to provide an outstanding experience for its patients. It aims to be the Bay Area's preferred destination for safe and effective anti-aging treatments and body-sculpting procedures, offering rejuvenating experiences in a setting comfortable for both men and women. TLC's approach is not just about aesthetic enhancement; it's about nurturing each patient's overall sense of well-being through excellent service and strong, trust-based patient relationships.

‍

partners.name: Barbarino Surgical Arts
partners.story:
Barbarino Surgical Arts, established by Sheila Barbarino, MD, FAAO, FAACS, FACS, is a premier cosmetic surgery institution spanning across two locations – the vivacious city of Austin, Texas, and the tranquil South Bay of California. The centers uphold a singular aim: enabling patients to fully realize their aesthetic aspirations. Dr. Barbarino, who is recognized far and wide as an exceptional cosmetic surgeon, navigates the field with her extensive knowledge and experience.

Sheila Barbarino, MD, FAAO, FAACS, FACS, is not merely a proficient cosmetic surgeon but also a recognized opinion leader in her field. Her techniques, which range from subtly enhancing features to conducting complete facelifts, are a testament to her mastery. Her ability to harness the latest technology and methods to deliver natural-looking results helps her patients feel their absolute best about their appearance.

The clinics, located in the heart of Austin and the South Bay, reflect the vibrant character of Dr. Barbarino. The bright, stylish interiors exude an air of classy sophistication that immediately puts visitors at ease. The clinics are often filled with the melodies of the 80s, Dr. Barbarino's favorite era, creating an inviting and relaxed atmosphere for patients.

The popularity of Barbarino Surgical Arts is well-documented in the numerous glowing reviews that abound on their website and social media platforms. Patients express appreciation for Dr. Barbarino's methodical approach to consultation, her comprehensive understanding of cosmetic surgery, and her balanced, scientific methodology for aesthetic enhancement.

One memorable review by a satisfied patient encapsulates the trust and admiration for Dr. Barbarino. The review lauds her for her meticulous attention to detail, her readiness to answer questions, and her dedicated patient care throughout the treatment journey. The patient further praised the state-of-the-art clinic facilities, the convenient location, and the supportive, friendly staff.

Sheila Barbarino, MD, FAAO, FAACS, FACS, is also a distinguished educator. Her numerous scholarly articles, studies, and publications in the field of cosmetic surgery reflect her unflagging dedication to the advancement of her field. Her unique techniques and soft touch transform each treatment into an experience that is both comfortable and rewarding.

Barbarino Surgical Arts represents more than a cosmetic surgery clinic – it is a sanctuary for those wishing to enhance their self-image and boost their confidence. With its two convenient locations, a dedicated team, and a commitment to helping patients achieve their best look, Barbarino Surgical Arts is a trendsetter in cosmetic surgery. At its helm, Sheila Barbarino, MD, FAAO, FAACS, FACS, continues to make her mark in the field, changing lives one patient at a time.

partners.name: Refined Aesthetics
partners.story:
Refined Aesthetics, nestled in the heart of Leesburg, Virginia, exudes a tranquil ambiance, harmonizing perfectly with its core mission. Clients are welcomed into a tastefully designed space that emanates warmth and hospitality, setting the stage for a personalized and relaxing experience. The team at Refined Aesthetics is not only devoted to delivering exceptional aesthetic services but also to fostering deep connections with each patient built on trust and understanding.

Under the meticulous guidance of its owner, Sarah Safa, MS, PAC, Refined Aesthetics has left an indelible mark on the facial aesthetics domain. Revered as a pioneer in the industry and celebrated as one of the top expert injectors on the East Coast, Sarah brings her wealth of knowledge and experience to every patient interaction. Her impressive career not only showcases her technical expertise but also highlights her dedication to patient education and empathy. Additionally, she has trained over 6,000 aesthetic medical providers across the country, a testament to her commitment to advancing the field.

At every step, Refined Aesthetics adopts a detail-oriented approach, prioritizing patients' unique aesthetic goals. Through clear communication and comprehensive education on recommended treatments, the practice ensures the comfort and satisfaction of its clientele. This meticulousness extends to the execution of aesthetic procedures, from advanced injections and precise facial mapping to laser treatments.

The team at Refined Aesthetics embodies both skill and adaptability. Firm believers in the power of continuous learning, they embrace ongoing training and mentorship, solidifying their commitment to providing unparalleled patient experiences. Selected for their precision and passion, each team member excels in delivering flawless, natural-looking results with non-surgical treatments.

Patient safety and satisfaction are paramount at Refined Aesthetics. In an ever-evolving aesthetics landscape, the practice remains at the forefront of innovative techniques and products. Sarah's profound knowledge of facial anatomy and aesthetic procedures ensures beautiful, natural-looking results that enhance and complement each patient's inherent beauty.

Renowned for its perfectionism and unmatched outcomes, Refined Aesthetics firmly believes in the significance of experience. This, combined with an unwavering pursuit of excellence, makes the practice a shining example of high-standard aesthetics and patient care. Beyond providing a service, the team at Refined Aesthetics crafts an extraordinary experience, inviting each patient into a world where beauty, comfort, and personalized care merge to create an unforgettable journey towards enhanced aesthetics.

partners.name: Holden Timeless Beauty
partners.story:
In the picturesque landscapes of San Diego, California, a beauty revolution is underway, led by the renowned establishment known as Holden Timeless Beauty. With four prominent locations in San Diego, San Marcos, Fallbrook, and Carlsbad, Holden Timeless Beauty offers a unique experience that celebrates individuality and fosters self-confidence. Firmly rooted in the heart of the community, the business is the realization of Dr. Amanda Holden's vision of authentic beauty, dedicated to empowering individuals to embrace their best selves.

Stepping into any Holden Timeless Beauty facility, clients embark on an immersive beauty journey, engaging all their senses – sight, sound, smell, and touch. This holistic approach creates a therapeutic experience, meticulously designed to welcome guests and initiate a transformative adventure.

Central to the Holden Timeless Beauty ethos is an unwavering commitment to employing the latest and most innovative aesthetics techniques. The staff is extensively trained, ensuring the delivery of natural and desirable results. Beyond technical proficiency, the hallmark of Holden Timeless Beauty lies in understanding and aligning with each client's unique goals and concerns, epitomizing a personalized and empathetic treatment approach.

Dr. Amanda Holden, the visionary behind this thriving establishment, is a woman of remarkable versatility and passion. As a long-term San Diego resident and UCSD alumna, she possesses an intimate understanding of her community. While initially charting her path in emergency medicine as Chief Resident at UCSD's Emergency Medicine Residency Program, Dr. Holden discovered her true calling in the realm of aesthetics. Her unwavering passion led her to the prestigious Allergan Master Course, culminating in a Master Injector Certificate. Today, she stands not only as the founder, owner, and Medical Director of Holden Timeless Beauty but as a prominent leader and driving force in Southern California's aesthetics industry. Highly respected for her expertise in administering Botox and Dermal Fillers, Dr. Holden extends her influence beyond her practice, actively shaping the future of medical aesthetics by educating and nurturing the next generation of practitioners.

Holden Timeless Beauty serves not just as a premier aesthetics practice but as a testament to Dr. Holden's unwavering vision. The clinics epitomize her dedication to beauty, self-confidence, and individual empowerment, providing sanctuaries where clients can reconnect with their authentic selves. Here, the definition of beauty transcends standardized norms, celebrating uniqueness and embracing the philosophy that aesthetic procedures are not solely about appearances but about fostering genuine self-confidence and a sense of timeless beauty.

From the inviting ambiance to personalized, cutting-edge treatment plans, Holden Timeless Beauty reflects Dr. Amanda Holden's unwavering dedication and passion for authentic beauty. These defining qualities make Holden Timeless Beauty a distinguished name in Southern California's aesthetics industry, setting new standards and empowering individuals on their journey to embracing their best, most confident selves.

partners.name: Esthetics Center
partners.story:
Established in the heart of California, Esthetics Center stands as a pillar of aesthetic care, fostering the principle that everyone has a right to feel secure, confident, and comfortable in their own skin. With strategic locations in El Dorado Hills, Rocklin, Sacramento, and Fair Oaks, it aims to provide accessible, high-quality aesthetic solutions to a broad demographic.

The Center acknowledges the deeply personal nature of aesthetic enhancements and offers a nurturing space where clients can freely express their concerns and aspirations. Offering services ranging from cosmetic surgery to medical spa treatments, the Esthetics Center provides comprehensive, personalized treatments for a variety of aesthetic concerns. Each client is presented with a clear, uncomplicated path to regain their confidence, designed with an understanding of their unique needs.

Guiding this client-focused approach is the Center's medical director, Dr. Rice. His robust background, including an education from Loma Linda University, specialized training in Facial Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery, and a double board-certification, ensures a high standard of professional care. Dr. Rice's leadership fortifies the Center's commitment to quality, precision, and client satisfaction.

Esthetics Center's dedication to its clients extends beyond professional treatment delivery. It realizes that the journey to self-confidence is as significant as the result itself. From initial consultations to final results, every interaction is treated with sensitivity, respect, and genuine care, ensuring that clients feel supported at every step.

Employing advanced techniques and state-of-the-art technology, the Center ensures that its services align with the latest industry standards. This commitment to innovation and excellence allows clients to benefit from treatments that deliver satisfying, transformational results.

Each client's unique journey is valued and respected, leading to the provision of bespoke solutions that cater specifically to their needs and aspirations. This personalized approach creates an environment that promotes self-acceptance and personal growth, making the Center more than just a provider of treatments, but a companion on the journey to self-confidence.

In summary, Esthetics Center offers more than aesthetic enhancements; it provides a sanctuary where individuals can rediscover their confidence through expert, personalized care. Its diverse range of services, its client-centric philosophy, and the expert leadership of Dr. Rice, make it a standout institution in the aesthetics industry. As beauty standards continue to evolve, Esthetics Center stands as a beacon of self-love and acceptance, embracing the power of aesthetics in fostering self-confidence and celebrating individuality.

kol.name: Michelle Paty
kol.title: Founder & Lead Injector
kol.bio:
Michelle Paty, MSN, CPNP-AC, FNP-C, is the founder and lead injector of Preva Aesthetics, a growing aesthetics practice with locations in Encinitas, California and Denver, Colorado. After beginning her career in pediatric critical care, Michelle transitioned into aesthetics with a vision for creating treatments that feel natural, preventative, and deeply personalized. Her thoughtful approach to patient care, combined with her passion for wellness and long-term skin health, has helped Preva build a loyal and rapidly growing community.

Under Michelle’s leadership, Preva has become known for its elevated patient experience and refined aesthetic philosophy centered around subtle enhancement rather than dramatic change. She has developed a distinctive approach that blends artistry with education, encouraging patients to take a more intentional and sustainable approach to aesthetics. As Preva continues to expand, Michelle remains committed to raising the standard of modern aesthetic care through authenticity, connection, and a strong sense of purpose.

kol.name: Alexa Nicholls Costa
kol.title: Founder & Clinical Director
kol.bio: Alexa Nicholls Costa, NP, is a Board-Certified Nurse Practitioner and the Founder and Chief Executive Officer of LexRx, Inject With Lex, and LexLab. Since founding LexRx in 2015, Alexa has grown the practice into a respected multi-location aesthetic brand with five locations across Massachusetts, while remaining fully founder-owned and built without outside investment. She completed a prestigious Emergency Medicine Fellowship through Brown University’s EMPED program and later practiced as a Nurse Practitioner in the Emergency Department at Massachusetts General Hospital, where she also gained clinical and research experience within the hospital’s Division of Plastic Surgery.In addition to leading LexRx, Alexa is a recognized Key Opinion Leader and educator in the aesthetic industry. She serves as a Founding Faculty member for Evolus Academy and as faculty for Galderma’s GAIN Business program. Through Inject With Lex, she has helped expand aesthetic injectables education to leading academic institutions including Boston College, Columbia University, and the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill. Alexa holds degrees from Boston University and Regis College, where she received the Master of Nursing Excellence Award. Through her work as a clinician, educator, and entrepreneur, she continues to help advance clinical standards in aesthetic medicine while shaping the next generation of aesthetic providers.

kol.name: Becky McDonald
kol.title: Co-Founder, Executive Director
kol.bio: Becky McDonald is a co-founder and Executive Director of Privé Med Spa, bringing a strong foundation in business operations, compliance, and leadership to the organization. With an Associate’s Degree in Business Administration, Becky built her early career in the banking industry, where she served in senior management roles and led the restructuring of operational departments while ensuring strict adherence to federal regulatory standards.Driven by an entrepreneurial vision, Becky transitioned from banking to healthcare aesthetics to help build and scale Privé into a nationally recognized practice. Her operational expertise and strategic oversight have been central to Privé’s growth, culture, and commitment to delivering an exceptional patient experience.

kol.name: Brandice Harrison
kol.title: Co-Founder, Master Aesthetic Specialist
kol.bio: Brandice Harrison, PA-C, is a co-founder and owner of Privé Med Spa and a nationally respected leader in medical aesthetics. A graduate of the University of Kentucky Physician Assistant Program, Brandice has been board certified by the National Commission on Certification of Physician Assistants since 2001. She began her medical career in surgery and emergency medicine before discovering her passion for non-surgical aesthetics in 2009.Known for her meticulous technique and refined aesthetic sensibility, Brandice is a highly sought-after trainer and speaker for Allergan Medical Institute and SkinMedica. She regularly shares her expertise with peers across the country, contributing to education, safety, and innovation within the aesthetic industry. Her leadership has been instrumental in shaping Privé’s reputation for natural results, elite clinical standards, and thoughtful patient care.

kol.name: Brandi Gregge
kol.title: Founder & Master Trainer
kol.bio: Brandi Gregge, MSN, FNP-BC, is the visionary founder and aesthetic injector of Mint & Needle, established in 2019 in Delaware. With an impressive academic background, including a Master’s in Nursing and an MBA, Brandi leverages over a decade of experience in medical and aesthetic practices to enhance patient care. She is celebrated for her innovative approach in regenerative medical aesthetics, earning multiple accolades such as Delaware Today’s Best MedSpa awards and recognition in Philadelphia Style Magazine. Brandi’s commitment extends beyond clinical practice as she conducts rigorous training programs for her staff, ensuring high standards in patient safety and care. A national influencer and speaker, she is dedicated to empowering individuals to feel confident in their skin. Passionate about natural beauty and wellness, Brandi continues to expand her influence, promoting a philosophy that combines health and aesthetics to help both men and women feel their best.

kol.name: Heather Badal
kol.title: Founder & Visionary
kol.bio: Heather Badal, co-founder and visionary behind Flawless Med Spa & Wellness in Albuquerque, New Mexico, is a distinguished leader in the aesthetic and wellness industry. With an Art History degree from Boston University and an MBA in International Business from the Thunderbird School of Global Management at Arizona State University, Heather's eclectic background enriches her approach to beauty and wellness. Before entering the med spa world, she pioneered Intel Corporation’s first Supplier Diversity program. In 2011, Heather shifted her focus to Flawless Med Spa, blending her passion for inclusive beauty with her business acumen. An avid philanthropist, Heather produced the documentary "Stopping Traffic" in 2019 to combat sex trafficking. She also serves on multiple boards, including the International Friends of the Prado and the Albuquerque Museum. Heather’s commitment extends to her personal interests in gardening, sound bath meditation, and kundalini yoga, enriching her holistic approach to life and work.

kol.name: Dr. Tanya Lawson
kol.title: Founder & Medical Director
kol.bio: Dr. Tanya Lawson, ND, is the esteemed founder and medical director of Inbloom Health + Medispa in Londonderry, New Hampshire. With a robust career that began in 2006, Dr. Lawson has pioneered integrative health centers and medispas focusing on noninvasive dermatological treatments and anti-aging procedures. Her innovative work has earned her multiple accolades, including "Young Entrepreneur of the Year" and recognition in the "Best of Windham" as the Best Doctor in 2020 and 2021. Dr. Lawson is also a celebrated educator, having taught at Loyalist College and presented at national conferences. As President of the Aesthetic Medical Providers of NH, she is a vanguard in aesthetic medicine, dedicated to merging wellness with aesthetics. Known for her warm, energetic approach, Dr. Lawson empowers her patients to take active roles in their wellness journeys, making significant impacts on their health and beauty goals. In her free time, she enjoys family life with her husband and three daughters.

kol.name: Dr. Stephen Giordano
kol.title: Founder of CAMI
kol.bio: Dr. Stephen Giordano, known affectionately as Dr. G, is the founder and medical director of Carolina Age Management Institute (CAMI) in North Carolina. Board-certified in Internal Medicine and a Diplomat of the American Academy of Anti-Aging and Regenerative Medicine (A4M), Dr. G specializes in a broad spectrum of minimally invasive and invasive procedures, including SmartLipo, skin tightening, and advanced hair restoration techniques. Since establishing CAMI, Dr. G has received multiple "Best of the City" and "Best Non-Surgical Facelift" awards, underscoring his excellence in aesthetic medicine. His practice is a pivotal training center for aesthetic medicine in North Carolina, reflecting his commitment to advancing the field. Outside the clinic, Dr. G, a former Division I Pole Vaulter and a lover of music, enjoys attending acoustic concerts and spending time with his family. His holistic approach to wellness is evident both in his personal life and professional practice, where he aims to enhance both the inner and outer beauty of his patients.

kol.name: Waseem Garbia
kol.title: FOUNDER & CEO
kol.bio: Waseem Garbia, PA-C, is a board-certified physician associate and an esteemed figure in the field of medical aesthetics. With over 21 years of experience in the medical field, specializing in aesthetics for 12 years, Waseem is the founder of Dontage, located in Fairfax, VA. He is renowned for his expertise in injectables and skin care, managing over 125 weekly appointments and administering 110,373 annual Botox units. Waseem is not only a national authority but also an international trainer for Allergan and Revance, where he serves as a Guru specialist. In this role, he conducts live international webinar trainings, sharing his extensive knowledge and pioneering techniques. His work spans across 48 states and four countries, making him a sought-after speaker and advisor in some of the largest facial aesthetic conferences globally. Waseem's passion for education and mentorship in aesthetics is matched by his commitment to providing tailored, high-quality treatments to his patients at Dontage.

kol.name: Michelle Doran
kol.title: Co-Founder
kol.bio:
Michelle Doran, MSN, APRN, BC, CANS, stands as a distinguished figure in the field of aesthetic medicine. As the co-founder and Clinical Director of RN Esthetics, she brings a profound expertise to her practice, highlighted by her role as a top national trainer for Allergan Medical Aesthetics and a clinical faculty trainer at The Academy for Injection Anatomy. Known for her meticulous aesthetic eye and artful consultations, Ms. Doran has a reputation for excellence in injectables, cannula techniques, laser treatments, and skincare.

Her educational background is equally impressive, having earned her BS from the University of Massachusetts Amherst and an MS from Boston College, graduating summa cum laude. Michelle is recognized as one of the top Allergan trainers in New England and is one of only twelve Aesthetic Masterminds in the US. Her commitment to advancing the field is evident in her numerous peer-reviewed publications and her dedication to mentoring the next generation of aesthetic specialists.

kol.name: Anne Therese Stubbs
kol.title: Founder & CEO
kol.bio: Anne Therese Stubbs, M.D., founder of Anne Therese Aesthetic Medicine and esteemed partner of Alpha Aesthetics Partners, stands out as a board-certified expert in minimally invasive aesthetic medicine. Dr. Anne's proficiency in facial injectables and aesthetic treatments is internationally recognized, earning her prestigious positions on the faculty boards of ZO Skin Health and Galderma. Her medical journey, marked by an undergraduate degree from the University of Notre Dame and an M.D. with honors from The Ohio State University, is complemented by a decade of practice in emergency medicine and a leadership role as Medical Director at Mount Carmel East Emergency Department. Today, Dr. Anne is not only a trusted figure in aesthetic medicine but also a respected medical consultant on NBC’s Daytime Columbus, where she shares the latest advancements in the field.

kol.name: Edwin F. Williams
kol.title: Founder & President
kol.bio:
Edwin Williams III, MD, FACS, a distinguished figure in facial plastic surgery, boasts a career marked by academic and clinical excellence since 1993. He holds dual board certifications in Facial Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery and Otolaryngology – Head and Neck Surgery. Specializing in Facial Rejuvenation and Rhinoplasty, Dr. Williams founded the Williams Center Plastic Surgery Specialists, overseeing its growth into a 21,000 square foot facility with over 75 staff members. His leadership extends to being the primary shareholder and managing partner, including the recent expansion to acquire Saratoga Hair Transplant Center.

Nationally and internationally recognized, Dr. Williams frequently presents at conferences and has been a pivotal member of the American Academy of Facial Plastic Surgery's Board of Directors for over a decade, serving as its President from 2015-2016. His expertise has earned him the Castle Connelly Top Doctors award in New York for Facial Plastic Surgery from 2016 to 2019. An active member of the Entrepreneur Organization, he contributes extensively to medical literature and educates resident doctors at Albany Medical Center. Dr. Williams, with over 30 years of practice, continues to mentor physicians, holding an academic appointment as Clinical Professor in the Department of Surgery and has been acknowledged with the American Medical Association Physician Recognition Award for his contributions to medical teaching.

kol.name: Dr. Sheila Barbarino
kol.title: Founder & Medical Director
kol.bio:
Meet Sheila Barbarino, MD, FAAO, FAACS, FACS, a true star in the world of aesthetics and an industry trailblazer! With numerous awards under her belt, Dr. Barbarino is a highly-skilled, results-driven cosmetic surgeon who has left her mark on the global stage as a world-renowned lecturer and key opinion and thought leader. She also has a passion for training, where she shares her knowledge of cutting-edge techniques for injectables, lasers, and aesthetic devices.

Dr. Barbarino is also a prolific author, with over 15 articles published in prestigious peer-reviewed journals. Her dedication to research and her passion for the artful fusion of medicine and aesthetics make her a force to be reckoned with.

Patients from near and far flock to her Austin and Los Angeles offices to experience her compassionate care and benefit from her years of clinical experience. Whether surgical or non-surgical, Dr. Barbarino's expertise shines through, helping her patients achieve the natural-looking facial and full body rejuvenation they've always dreamed of.

kol.name: Amanda Holden
kol.title: Founder
kol.bio: Dr. Amanda Holden, a San Diego resident for over 30 years and a UCSD alumna, has crafted a remarkable journey from emergency medicine to the refined artistry of medical aesthetics. After earning her medical degree and serving as Chief Resident at UCSD's Emergency Medicine Residency Program, she found her true calling in aesthetics. Her passion and dedication led her to the prestigious Allergan Master Course, where she emerged with a Master Injector Certificate. Today, she stands as the founder, owner, and Medical Director of Holden Timeless Beauty, a leading provider of Botox and Dermal Fillers in Southern California. Beyond running her own practice, she shapes the future of the aesthetics industry by educating and training the next generation of medical aesthetics practitioners. Dedicated, versatile, and passionate, Dr. Holden's vision encapsulates her commitment to enhancing beauty and inspiring individuals to become the best versions of themselves.

kol.name: Reginald Rice
kol.title: Founder & Medical Director
kol.bio:
Dr. Rice, the esteemed Medical Director of Esthetics Center, has over two decades of expertise in Otolaryngology—head and neck surgery, combined with a genuine passion for facial aesthetics. His exceptional career has honed his proficiency in specialized areas such as Body Contouring, Liposuction, and Advanced Laser Technologies. Double board-certified in Otolaryngology and Facial Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery, Dr. Rice stands as a leading authority in the field. With thousands of successful operations and a continuous pursuit of knowledge, Dr. Rice remains at the forefront of cutting-edge techniques. Beyond his remarkable work at Esthetics Center, his philanthropic endeavors reflect a true dedication to improving lives. Having provided free medical and surgical care to children in Central and South America, he embodies compassion and altruism. Under Dr. Rice's expert guidance, Esthetics Center represents the epitome of quality and professionalism. Clients can confidently entrust their care to this seasoned professional, assured of receiving exceptional treatment and achieving beautiful, natural-looking results.

‍

kol.name: Katie Martin
kol.title: Director of Clinical Operations
kol.bio: As the Vice President of Clinical Operations at Holden Timeless Beauty (HTB), Katie Martin, a board-certified Physician Assistant, has distinguished herself in the field of medical aesthetics since 2015. She has become an instrumental figure in the industry with her proficiency in medical-grade skincare regimens, earning her the title of "Sculptra Queen" at HTB. A passionate educator, Katie demonstrates a commitment to mentorship, sharing her extensive knowledge with both clients and fellow injectors. Widely sought after as a Galderma GAIN trainer, she imparts her wisdom in safe injection techniques to practitioners nationwide, advocating for natural outcomes. In shifting her career from emergency medicine to aesthetics, Katie discovered her professional passion. In collaboration with Dr. Amanda Holden, she has significantly impacted the landscape of aesthetics, co-founding True to You Medical Aesthetics and The Academy of Medical Aesthetics. Her continuing efforts to uplift and educate are a testament to her influential role in the industry.

kol.name: Sarah Safa
kol.title: Founder & Chief Injector
kol.bio: Sarah Safa, MS, PAC, the founder of Refined Aesthetics, is an esteemed pioneer in the field of aesthetic medicine with over 20 years of experience in plastic and reconstructive surgery. With her mastery of facial anatomy, she excels in restoring balance and symmetry to faces, establishing herself as one of the top expert injectors in the country. Her precise approach to laser treatments, advanced injections, and facial mapping is unmatched. Sarah has distinguished herself as an extraordinary educator, having trained over 6,000 aesthetic medical providers hands-on across the nation. Her profound influence extends to her lectures for the American Association of Surgical Physician Assistants and the American Med Spa Association on innovative non-surgical trends and advanced lower facial rejuvenation techniques, respectively. As an influential figure, Sarah serves on multiple advisory boards, including The Aesthetic Masterminds and The Academy for Injection Anatomy, affirming her leadership in the aesthetic industry.

team.name: Alexandra FitzPatrick
team.title: IT Analyst
team.bio:
Alexandra FitzPatrick, IT Analyst at Alpha, supports partners across a wide range of technology needs, helping ensure day-to-day operations run smoothly. From EMR systems and email support to phones and other core platforms, she works closely with partners and the IT team to troubleshoot issues, improve systems, and support the evolving needs of the business.

Alexandra collaborates directly with partners while also working alongside Alpha’s IT team to strengthen and streamline the company’s technology infrastructure. With the fast-paced nature of the industry, her role is constantly evolving, requiring adaptability, problem-solving, and a hands-on approach to support.

‍
team.experience:
Prior to joining Alpha, Alexandra worked with Esthetics Center, Alpha’s first partner. She brings four years of experience in the medical aesthetics space, including one year with Alpha.

Alexandra loves having the opportunity to travel and work directly with partners across the country. She enjoys getting to know each team, learning how practices operate, and being able to provide hands-on support that helps teams succeed.

team.name: Preston Chakara
team.title: Manager, New Partnerships
team.bio:
Manager, New Partnerships Preston Chakara leads the financial side of Alpha’s new partnership process, overseeing valuations, due diligence, and deal structuring for prospective partners joining the platform. He works closely with practice owners and their teams to understand the full financial picture of their business, ensuring every valuation is thoughtful, transparent, and grounded in the story behind the numbers.

In his role, Preston partners with Alpha’s leadership, investors, and lenders to align on deal economics and help build strong foundations for long-term success. He focuses on making diligence feel collaborative rather than invasive, guiding partners through the process with clear communication and helping them understand both the value of what they have built and the opportunities ahead.
team.experience:
Prior to joining Alpha, Preston worked with notable organizations including Deloitte Consulting, NewSpring Capital, Sonepar, and Incora. Across his eight-year career, he has supported dozens of M&A transactions and helped design long-term strategic programs for the federal government.

Preston loves getting to know the owners behind each practice and hearing the story of how they built something meaningful from the ground up. He finds it especially rewarding to combine relationship-building with valuation strategy, helping partners move forward with confidence while knowing their legacy is respected.

‍

team.name: Eric Redd
team.title: VP, Corporate Controller
team.bio:
Eric Redd, the VP Corporate Controller at Alpha, supports partners by ensuring they have reliable, accurate, and timely financial reporting they can confidently use to make decisions. He focuses on driving consistency and quality control across financial processes, strengthening internal controls, and ensuring operational systems align with financial reporting. Eric also works closely with partners to help explain financial performance and provide clarity around key business drivers.

In his role, Eric leads Alpha’s corporate accounting and financial reporting functions, helping build the financial infrastructure needed to support a growing organization. He plays a key part in acquisition integration, audit readiness, internal controls, and the development of scalable accounting processes that support both operational visibility and long-term growth across the platform.

‍
team.experience:
Eric is deeply passionate about accounting and finance and values building strong partnerships between operations and finance teams. He enjoys helping make complex financial concepts more approachable and believes clear communication is key to strong decision-making.

Prior to joining Alpha, Eric held roles with organizations including Anixter International, Leo Burnett, and Pactiv. Over the course of his 20-year career, he has contributed to large-scale ERP implementations and helped design and build financial departments for multiple private equity portfolio companies.

team.name: Andrea Beck
team.title: CMO
team.bio:
Chief Marketing Officer Andrea Beck leads marketing strategy and operations across Alpha’s partner network, helping each practice grow while preserving what makes it unique. Her team’s work spans the full breadth of marketing, including brand strategy, digital marketing, patient lifecycle communications, analytics, agency management, and the technology infrastructure that supports scalable growth. Andrea works closely with partners, operators, leadership, and external agencies to create marketing systems that are aligned, measurable, and effective.

In her role, Andrea supports partners by helping their brands stand out in meaningful and authentic ways. She focuses on building awareness, strengthening reputation and credibility, improving patient retention, and helping every marketing investment work harder. Through collaboration, data, and thoughtful strategy, she helps practices make smarter decisions while creating stronger connections with both new and existing patients.
team.experience:
Andrea loves the balance of strategy, creativity, problem-solving, and partnership that her role requires. She enjoys helping practices translate their unique stories into marketing that feels authentic while also driving measurable growth. She is especially energized by bringing structure to complex challenges and helping partner teams feel more supported, confident, and equipped to grow.

Prior to joining Alpha, Andrea has worked with notable organizations including ACE Cash Express and CMO Consulting Group. Throughout nearly two decades in marketing leadership, Andrea has built a career centered around brand growth, operational strategy, and creating systems that help businesses scale thoughtfully.

‍

team.name: Jelicia Acevedo Alequin
team.title: Senior Accountant
team.bio:
Senior Accountant Jelicia Acevedo Alequin supports Alpha’s partners by providing clear, proactive guidance that helps them operate confidently and stay compliant. She works closely with partner administrators to clarify financial processes, product usage, and reporting requirements, translating complex details into practical, day-to-day guidance that aligns with GAAP standards.

In her role, Jelicia leads the month-end close process for her assigned partners, ensuring timely and accurate financial reporting. Her responsibilities include preparing journal entries, completing account reconciliations, and supporting controller reviews, as well as assisting with audit requests and documentation.
team.experience:
Jelicia enjoys taking complex financial data and turning it into clear, meaningful insights that help leaders understand what’s happening at both the operational and financial levels.

Prior to joining Alpha, Jelicia worked at CHRISTUS Health, Evoque DCS, and WWEX Group. With 10 years of experience, she has worked across a wide range of accounting functions, giving her a strong, practical understanding of how financial operations come together.

team.name: Katie Blaschak
team.title: Director of HR
team.bio:
Katie Blaschak, Director of Human Resources, supports Alpha’s partners by helping them navigate all things people, from hiring and retention to leadership support and team development. She focuses on creating structure as the organization grows, ensuring practices have the right people in the right roles and the support needed to stay focused on patient care.

In her role, Katie leads HR and people operations across Alpha and its partner practices. She oversees recruiting, employee relations, performance management, compensation, and policy development, while also coaching leaders and supporting teams through day-to-day challenges. She plays a key role in building programs and processes that create consistency across practices while allowing for thoughtful, sustainable growth.

‍
team.experience:
Katie loves helping people navigate challenging moments at work and come out stronger on the other side. She finds purpose in supporting both leaders and team members through growth, change, and development.

Prior to joining Alpha, Katie worked at Gap Inc., Five Below, and Advance Auto Parts. With more than 13 years of experience in HR and people operations, she brings a well-rounded background in talent acquisition, employee relations, and organizational growth.

team.name: Rachel Morin
team.title: Compensation Analyst
team.bio:
Rachel Morin, Compensation Analyst, supports Alpha’s partners by managing provider payroll calculations and incentive structures, ensuring accuracy while identifying trends that inform forecasting and performance. She focuses on streamlining processes and building scalable systems that reduce manual work, helping alleviate the administrative burden so partners can stay focused on their teams and patients.

In her role, Rachel operates at the intersection of Finance, Operations, and HR, translating complex compensation data into clear, actionable insights. She manages and optimizes bonus plans and incentive structures to align with business goals, while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and efficiency across all compensation processes.

‍
team.experience:
Prior to joining Alpha, Rachel worked with Azul Cosmetic Surgery under the Aesthetic Partners umbrella, and InBloom Health + Medispa, one of Alpha’s current partners. She holds certifications in multiple coding languages and a Master's degree in Clinical Data Analytics, bringing a strong analytical foundation to her role.

Rachel loves that her role challenges her to combine her passion for the aesthetics industry with her strength in data. She enjoys understanding the “why” behind problems and takes pride in not just identifying solutions, but building them.

team.name: Michelle Ruffin
team.title: Payroll Manager
team.bio:
Michelle Ruffin, Payroll Manager, plays a critical role in ensuring Alpha runs smoothly by overseeing payroll across all partners. She is responsible for processing payroll accurately and on time, including bi-weekly payroll, bonuses, and partner compensation, while managing Paylocity, reviewing timecards, and maintaining compliance with federal, state, and local regulations.

In her role, Michelle supports managers, employees, and partners by answering payroll questions, resolving issues efficiently, and improving processes to ensure accuracy across all systems. She works closely with HR, Benefits, and Finance to maintain clean, reliable payroll data and bring consistency to every pay cycle.
team.experience:
Prior to joining Alpha, Michelle worked at Community Veterinary Partners and Endo Pharmaceuticals. With 40 years of experience, she brings deep expertise and reliability to her role as Payroll Manager.

Michelle loves the responsibility and trust that comes with her role. She takes pride in her accuracy, attention to detail, and consistency, knowing her work directly supports employees across the organization. While payroll happens behind the scenes, she values the impact it has in creating a smooth, dependable experience for every team member.

team.name: Bear Beltz
team.title: Senior Accountant
team.bio:
Bear Beltz, Senior Accountant at Alpha, supports partners by serving as a dedicated point of contact for all P&L and balance sheet matters, helping ensure a smooth and consistent month-end close. He provides responsive support, operational guidance, and a solutions-oriented approach, playing a key role in maintaining strong financial clarity across the portfolio.

In his role, Bear manages full P&L and balance sheet reviews for multiple partners, including revenue, COGS, operating expenses, accruals, and financial analysis for leadership review. He is also responsible for banking activity, intangible assets, and supporting company-wide audit processes, ensuring accuracy and consistency across all reporting.
team.experience:
Bear loves the clarity and impact his work brings. He enjoys turning complex data into clean, reliable financials that leadership can trust, and values the opportunity to see how individual decisions contribute to the broader financial picture. The problem-solving aspect of the role keeps him engaged, and he takes pride in the ownership and accountability that comes with producing work others rely on.

Prior to joining Alpha, Bear worked at Worldwide Express, Innocean, Kofax, and Ford. With 12 years of experience, he brings a strong foundation in financial reporting, analysis, and process improvement.

team.name: Matthew Feldman
team.title: Operations Analyst
team.bio:
Matt Feldman, Operations Analyst, supports Alpha’s partners by translating data into clear, actionable insights that drive performance. He develops reporting across key metrics like revenue, utilization, retention, and provider productivity, helping teams identify opportunities and make informed decisions.

In his role, Matt partners cross-functionally with operations, finance, marketing, and leadership to uncover trends and guide strategy. His work centers on building reporting that connects directly to performance, ensuring data is not only understood, but used effectively. He loves that his role allows him to work across every department and clinic, creating a meaningful impact across the organization. He finds it rewarding to see how data influences decisions and drives results, and values being part of a growing team.
team.experience: Prior to joining Alpha, Matt worked at Expeditors, Peoples Bancorp of North Carolina, and Cvent. With seven years of experience as a professional analyst, he has supported large-scale growth initiatives, including data analysis tied to $20M+ in client renewals, and was recognized as a Top Analyst Performer in 2023.

team.name: Jessica York
team.title: Director of Operations - East Coast
team.bio:
Director of Operations, East Coast Jessica York serves as a key operational partner to Alpha’s practices, helping turn vision into consistent performance. She focuses on removing roadblocks and bringing structure to daily operations so each practice can grow while maintaining a high standard of care. Jessica works closely with partners and clinic leaders to build strong teams, develop leaders, and foster a culture people are proud to be part of.

In her role, Jessica oversees operations across multiple East Coast practices, driving alignment, consistency, and performance. She partners with clinic leaders to set clear goals, coach teams, and implement strategies that support growth and profitability, while ensuring an elevated patient experience. She loves watching teams grow in confidence and performance, and seeing the direct impact that strong operations can have on a practice. She finds it especially rewarding to help turn vision into reality and create environments where people are proud to work.
team.experience: Prior to joining Alpha, Jessica held roles at Best Buy, MyEyeDr., and Advanced MedAesthetic Partners. With eight years of experience as a Director of Operations, including three in aesthetics, she brings a strong foundation in multi-site leadership and performance management.

team.name: Jeff Peel
team.title: COO
team.bio:
Chief Operating Officer Jeff Peel plays a central role in supporting Alpha’s partners through operations, integrations, and marketing alignment. He believes that the most effective answers are found within the clinics themselves, where a close understanding of day-to-day operations provides clarity on what matters most. That clarity informs focus, and ultimately builds the conviction needed to execute at a high level. Jeff prioritizes staying closely connected to both partners and the team members who serve patients, ensuring that decisions are made with every stakeholder in mind and that each voice has a seat at the table.

In his role, Jeff leads with a balance of strategy and execution. He works closely with partners to identify opportunities within their businesses and collaborates on solutions that enhance both the patient experience and team performance. His approach is rooted in thoughtful planning, strong operational discipline, and a commitment to building systems that support long-term, sustainable growth across the organization.
team.experience:
Jeff loves that his role allows him to work closely with people and build strong, high-performing teams. He finds energy in problem solving, training, and building from the ground up, especially in environments that require thoughtful execution. Leading teams and unlocking their potential is a core part of what he enjoys most, and he embraces challenges as opportunities for growth for both himself and the teams he supports.

Prior to joining Alpha, Jeff held leadership roles at 24 Hour Fitness, Gold's Gym, HearingLife, and Artemis Wax, where he built a strong foundation in multi-unit operations and team leadership. Throughout his career, he has been recognized for his performance, earning Regional Vice President of the Year honors twice across two different regions. With nearly three years of experience as Chief Operating Officer at Alpha, he continues to bring a hands-on, people-first approach to supporting partners and driving operational excellence.

team.name: Riley Haydock
team.title: Senior Manager, Partnership Marketing
team.bio:
Senior Manager, Partnership Marketing Riley Haydock serves as the connection point between Alpha’s partners, internal teams, and external marketing agencies, ensuring alignment across all marketing efforts. She takes a listening-first approach, working to understand each partner’s goals, challenges, and vision so she can advocate for them and support execution. Riley operates as a true extension of each partner’s team, focused on building trust and keeping initiatives moving forward.

In her role, Riley works closely with partners to provide clarity and support across marketing strategy and execution. She ensures partners feel informed, aligned, and confident in the direction of their brand.
team.experience:
Riley loves getting to know the story behind each partner. She is especially drawn to understanding the “why” behind their brand, from how they chose their name to the details that shape their identity. Bringing those stories to life through thoughtful messaging allows her to advocate for partners in a meaningful way.

With five years of professional experience, Riley brings a strong foundation in partnership marketing and brand storytelling to her role at Alpha.

team.name: Julia Stiger
team.title: Content & Communications Specialist
team.bio:
Julia Stiger, Content & Communications Specialist, manages Alpha’s social media platforms, leading content strategy and execution across each channel. She supports partner launches, is involved in the production of Alpha’s podcast network, and works to keep marketing efforts aligned across the partner portfolio. Julia also travels with Alpha’s leadership and M&A teams to capture content in real time at industry events and conferences, helping tell the story of what’s happening across the business.

Through her role, Julia supports Alpha’s partners by amplifying their presence across social channels. She brings visibility to partner milestones, achievements, and day-to-day moments through engaging content that highlights what makes each practice unique. She also contributes to branded asset creation and website initiatives, helping ensure each partner is represented in a way that feels both elevated and authentic.
team.experience:
Prior to joining Alpha, Julia worked with the Port of San Diego and Children's Miracle Network. With two years of experience, she brings a thoughtful and growing skill set in content creation, communications, and graphic design.

Julia loves that her role allows her to be creative every day while using storytelling to grow Alpha’s presence and build awareness. She enjoys working behind the scenes to support how the brand shows up and takes pride in ensuring partners are represented thoughtfully across every touchpoint.

team.name: Lydia Williams
team.title: FP&A Analyst
team.bio:
As an FP&A analyst, Lydia supports Alpha’s partners by delivering clear, data-driven insights that guide strategic decision-making. She prepares consolidated financial reports, identifies trends across the business, and conducts scenario analyses to support key initiatives. During the budgeting process, she works closely with partners to align financial goals with operational plans, crafting a roadmap tailored to each business’s needs. Her work ensures partners have the financial clarity and confidence needed to make informed decisions.

At Alpha, Lydia works at the corporate level as a Financial Planning & Analysis Analyst, supporting forecasting, budgeting, and strategic planning across the organization. She prepares and analyzes consolidated financial reports, monitors key performance indicators, and delivers actionable insights to senior leadership. Her collaboration with departments throughout the organization helps align financial goals with operational strategy. Lydia’s work plays a key role in supporting Alpha’s growth through financial transparency and data-informed decisions.
team.experience: Lydia is a graduate of Siena College and a proud alumna of GE’s Financial Management Program, a highly selective two-year rotational program. Through this program, she gained experience in FP&A, Supply Chain, Commercial Finance, and Finance Transformation, while also engaging with senior leadership and completing rigorous coursework. This experience built a strong foundation in business finance and positioned her for success in her current role at Alpha.

team.name: Sarah Kiser
team.title: Accounts Payable Manager
team.bio:
As Accounts Payable Manager, Sarah's primary goal is to take the lift of vendor relationship maintenance off of partners. team.name: Brittany McMahon
team.title: Director of Operations - East Coast
team.bio:
Brittany McMahon, the Director of Operations for the East Coast at Alpha Aesthetics Partners, plays a critical role in providing unwavering support and resourcefulness to partners. She serves as a reliable and steadfast pillar that partners can depend on for comprehensive assistance in any area of need. team.name: Jess Hernandez

Jess is responsible for identifying and resolving any issues with payables, ensuring timely solutions are found to prevent future complications. team.name: Sticky

team.name: Tyler Stewart

team.name: Kristina Williams

team.bio:
